title: RAPID: analysis reproduction package
description: Code and data to reproduce the analyses of the RAPID manuscript from stored structure-prediction results. Solubility scores use SoluProt 1.0.1.0 (TMHMM-independent model). The reproduction script re-runs eleven analyses and compares 16,035 values with the committed results.
